verdict_scope: Lock-only transitive bump soupsieve 2.8.4->2.9 in root uv.lock. (1) Lock consistency is verified: uv lock --check --offline passed with 276 packages, and the only semantic delta is the soupsieve version plus its artifact metadata. (2) The repo's BeautifulSoup usage is verified in an isolated env with bs4 4.14.3 and soupsieve 2.9. The repo calls html.parser, soup([...]) find_all, decompose and get_text, and none of those route through soupsieve's CSS engine. (3) Upstream SoupSieve 2.9 selector semantics beyond the smoke checks, and the repo's own test suites, were not exercised.
